description: This file is a shell script designed for testing shallow cloning of Git repositories with submodules. It includes setup steps, multiple test cases verifying behaviors of shallow and non-shallow clones, and submodule configurations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to execute after tests.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified message.

methods.name: git
methods.description: Invokes Git commands for cloning, log retrieval, submodule addition, and configuration.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Verifies the number of lines in the output.
